kurz: Pasta is a [[glutenbildung|gluten network]] with starch. The network gives bite; the starch in the cooking water helps the sauce cling.
bild_im_kopf: Like a net full of paste: on the outside it releases starch, on the inside the net holds.
was_passiert: When cooking, the starch swells and the gluten network holds the shape. Part of the starch goes into the water, which is why it is valuable for the sauce.
warum_wichtig: Bite and a bound sauce come together in the last two minutes: in the pan with pasta water.
faustregeln: Salt the cooking water, but do not oversalt it.
Drain just before al dente and finish cooking in the sauce.
Keep a cup of pasta water.
